b2-falutortenet-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Life on the Tanya
b2-falutortenet-01.scenario: At a tanya museum on the sandy plain between the Danube and the Tisza, a visitor asks you how the families on the isolated farmsteads lived.
b2-falutortenet-01.prompt: Tell the visitor how the tanya families lived and what they paid for it.
cues: Say what the family produced itself
Say what suffered because of the work
b2-falutortenet-01.target: A tanyán élő család sok mindent maga termelt. Ez gyakran a gyerekek tanulásának rovására ment.
b2-falutortenet-01.english: The family living on the tanya produced a lot itself. This often came at the expense of the children's studies.
b2-falutortenet-01.canDo: I can describe the isolated social and economic structure of the Alföld tanya world.

b2-falutortenet-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Land in 1945 and After
b2-falutortenet-02.scenario: In a village museum on the Great Plain, a visitor asks you what happened to the land in 1945 and in the years after.
b2-falutortenet-02.prompt: Tell the visitor for whom the land was distributed in 1945 and who bore the cost of collectivization.
cues: Say who the land reform benefited
Say who bore the cost of collectivization
b2-falutortenet-02.target: 1945-ben a földosztás a nincstelen parasztok javára történt. A kollektivizálás a parasztok rovására ment.
b2-falutortenet-02.english: In 1945 the land reform took place for the benefit of the landless peasants. Collectivization came at the peasants' expense.
b2-falutortenet-02.canDo: I can recount the 1945 land reform and the subsequent forced collectivization campaign.

b2-falutortenet-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Household Plot
b2-falutortenet-03.scenario: In a village of cube houses, a visitor asks you how families managed to build such houses in the Kádár era.
b2-falutortenet-03.prompt: Tell the visitor what the household plot was and what the families' income depended on.
cues: Say what the household plot was
Say what the income depended on
b2-falutortenet-03.target: A háztáji gazdaság kis családi gazdaság volt a téesz mellett. A családok bevétele a munka és a piaci árak függvényében emelkedett.
b2-falutortenet-03.english: The household plot was a small family farm alongside the cooperative. Family income rose depending on the labour and market prices.
b2-falutortenet-03.canDo: I can explain the dual economy of Hungarian collectivized agriculture (háztáji gazdaság).

b2-falutortenet-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Emptying Villages
b2-falutortenet-04.scenario: At a meeting in a tiny village in the Ormánság, a visitor asks you why the young left and who helps the elderly.
b2-falutortenet-04.prompt: Tell the visitor why the young left and what the village caretaker does.
cues: Say what the village caretaker does
b2-falutortenet-04.target: Munkahelyek híján a fiatalok a városokba költöztek. A falugondnok ebédet és gyógyszert szállít az időseknek.
b2-falutortenet-04.english: For lack of jobs the young moved to the towns. The village caretaker delivers lunch and medicine to the elderly.
b2-falutortenet-04.canDo: I can analyze the causes and consequences of post-1990 rural depopulation in Hungary.

b2-falutortenet-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Moving Back to the Village
b2-falutortenet-05.scenario: In a wine cellar (présház) in the Balaton-felvidék, a visitor asks you why some people are moving back to villages.
b2-falutortenet-05.prompt: Tell the visitor what the returnees get in exchange for the constraints of village life.
cues: Say how they can keep their work
b2-falutortenet-05.target: A visszaköltözők a nyugalom ellenében vállalják a falusi élet kötöttségeit. Sokan távmunkát végeznek.
b2-falutortenet-05.english: In return for peace, the returnees take on the constraints of village life. Many do remote work.
b2-falutortenet-05.canDo: I can describe the renaissance of rural living through winemaking, agritourism, and remote work.

b2-falutortenet-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Century of the Village
b2-falutortenet-consolidation.scenario: On a train across the Great Plain, a student asks you to sum up in a few lines what happened to the Hungarian village.
b2-falutortenet-consolidation.prompt: Tell the student at whose expense collectivization came and why small villages lost their young people.
cues: Say at whose expense the cooperatives came
Say why the villages lost their young
b2-falutortenet-consolidation.target: A kollektivizálás a parasztok rovására ment. Később munkahelyek híján a fiatalok elhagyták az aprófalvakat.
b2-falutortenet-consolidation.english: Collectivization came at the peasants' expense. Later, for lack of jobs, the young left the tiny villages.
b2-falutortenet-consolidation.canDo: I can trace the 20th- and 21st-century transformation of Hungarian rural life from the tanya to today.
